data.title: 2H 2021 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
The number of requests Daum and Kakao received from the government for communication data was similar to those received during the first half of 2021. Kakao has not provided communication data since the first half of 2013.
In response to requests for data on communication-restricting measures in Daum services, only data that strictly pertain to standards are provided after thorough review is conducted in accordance to relevant legislations. We do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures that pertain to Kakao services.
The number of requests for communication confirmation data and processed requests related to Daum services has decreased slightly compared to the first half of 2021. Meanwhile, the number of requests and processed requests related to Kakao services has increased by 23.1% and 28.0% respectively since the first half of 2021.
Requests for search and seizure warrants related to Daum services have decreased by 15.4%, while those for Kakao services have increased by 6.2% compared to the first half of 2021.
The number of accounts processed in response to search and seizure warrants related to Daum and Kakao services has decreased by 62.8% and 31.7% respectively compared to the first half of 2021. Kakao strives to provide only the minimum information necessary to meet the requirements.
